title: Automatic Counterfactual Augmentation for Robust Text Classification Based on Word-Group Search

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Perturbation Consistency Rate (PCR) via counterfactual substitution of gender attribute terms (e.g., replacing 'She' with 'He') to see if predictions change, and calculating False Positive Equality Difference (FPED) and False Negative Equality Difference (FNED) to evaluate error rate balance across male and female groups.
